in_marathi.name: Shibu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shibu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shibu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shiva', which means 'auspicious' or 'blessed'. It is also derived from the Malayalam word 'shibu', which means 'tranquility' or 'calmness'.

in_bengali.name: Shibu
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shibu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Shibu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shiva', which means 'auspicious' or 'blessed'. It is also derived from the Malayalam word 'shibu', which means 'tranquility' or 'calmness'.
